answer: Renewable scarce lease slots: each identity must hold a capped, expiring lease renewed with a nonrefundable fee, and transfers cool down before reuse. A meadow operator pays this fee plus locked prepaid rent for every clone, while unused leases lapse. Clones cannot recycle fast enough across a glacier of waiting time to profit from duplicates. Each marginal voyage into sybil creation costs more in renewals, lockup, and expired rent than its expected gain.
